name: Hirō Shrine
text: Shinto shrine in Wakayama Prefecture, Japan.

depictions.name: Hiro Shrine
depictions.text: Hiro Shrine is a Shinto shrine in Wakayama Prefecture, Japan. During the Sengoku period, it was situated north of Kumano Nachi Taisha in Kii Province.
